Sony Signs MoU With Saudi Aramco to Advance AI-Powered Industrial Collaboration
Sony Group is teaming up with Saudi Aramco to advance artificial intelligence capabilities in the industrial sector.
The Japanese entertainment and electronics company said Monday that it aims to combine its sensing and AI technologies with Aramco's extensive industrial data and operational experience.
The Japanese company said its chip unit signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding with the Saudi energy company's subsidiary in Japan.
